opening.argument: The video links funding an MTI account with making Bitcoin, then directs viewers to send Bitcoin through a QR code or wallet address. It requires transaction details and proof of payment through a submission form, while stating that the transfer will appear in the trading account after administrator confirmation. Paid-member and trading-bonus displays, together with registration fields and an invitation to refer friends, reinforce a pathway of payment and recruitment rather than merely describing an account. These features present funding as a route to Bitcoin earnings and support the stated investment-pool, lending, or staking-returns characterization. The available evidence does not establish who controls the wallet, whether any transfer occurred, or whether the displayed results were realized.

citations.quote: How to fund MTI Mirror Trading International account & make money bitcoin
You can either scan the QR code or carefully copy the Bitcoin address to your wallet. Make the payment by sending the Bitcoin.
Should you wish to refer your friends, you can send them your registration link or you can help them register by clicking on the downline registration link.
